paquet:ordres-directs:P1.summary:
P1 is in place, all its tests pass, and tsc is clean. The new folder src/ui/command/direct/ holds the pure logic for direct orders (French comments and strings):
- words.ts: the new F wheel (1 Avec moi with 2 as a hidden alias, 3 Envoyer, 4 Bloquer une rue, 5 Interpeller, 6 Disperser, 7 Secours ici, 8 Plus…), the « Plus… » ring (1–8 unchanged, 9 Pousser un véhicule), the pill short forms with a font-width table and fitsPill, the words of each verb, distance and duration formatting, place names with their article, offender names (« le lanceur de projectile ») and the §5 detainee and van strings.
- natural.ts: naturalOrder(env, designation, who), rules a to i of §1.3. Disperser, Charger and gaz are never the ordre prêt. It also builds the « autre » line (Maj+Entrée): Disperser with sommations first, or Envoyer without blocking. holdNatural keeps a new line off screen for 0.5 s and flashes a fresh one.
- who.ts: the free rule, the automatic addressee per poste (never the company root, units given an order less than 20 s ago skipped, oldest order otherwise and the line says what it leaves), the fixed U cycle, a manual choice valid for one order with the next U going straight back to it, and resolveWho.
- caps.ts: what each unit kind accepts, the refusal sentences of §4.2–4.3, and the plain words for every sim refusal reason. The test scans src/sim/police and fails on any unmapped reason.
- travel.ts: motorizes / travelOf, one rule for when to drive.
- tickets.ts: the pure ticket reducer next(), readiness(), ticketText() and expired(), with the exact §3.1 texts.
- state.ts: unitLine() and groupSummary() (never « sans ordre » for a unit under command).
- types.ts, env.ts (read-only builder directEnvFromCore and designationAt for tests), index.ts.

Contracts: Button gets 'order_go' | 'order_who' | 'order_undo' | 'with_me', SquadOrder gets byPlayer?, RadioMessage gets silent? and reply?.

intents.ts: MOTOR_DISTANCE is gone and etaFor uses travelOf. The « Y aller » explanation now says 450 m / 150 m. With no offence near the point, the Interpeller line reads « Aller constater » / « Personne n'a rien commis ici : ils surveillent. ». Encercler is hidden from the crowd card and from the candidates with fewer than 2 units (encircleUnitCount, the BRAV-M counted once). bestUnit.travel uses the same rule and passes whether the player is aboard.

The user asked to save everything in case the Mac battery dies. I did not commit (the workflow forbids it); a patch and an archive of the new files are in /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-SafeDeal/f854eafd-7c66-528c-834c-30dfeec78944/scratchpad/ordres-directs/sauvegarde-P1/ (P1-modifs.patch, P1-nouveaux-fichiers.tgz).
paquet:ordres-directs:P1.testsRun:
Final runs after the last changes:
- npx tsc --noEmit -p . : exit 0, no errors.
- tests/unit/ui-command.direct-logique.test.ts (new, 31 tests) + ui-command.direct-tickets.test.ts (new, 14 tests): 45/45 pass.
- All 27 tests/unit/ui-command.*.test.ts files (the two new ones included), plus playtest.commandant-interpeller and input.bindings, run in two groups after the core.ts change: 14 files / 149 tests pass and 15 files / 157 tests pass.
- Re-run after the very last edit (natural.ts rescue rule, encircleUnitCount BRAV-M rule): direct-logique, direct-tickets, fiches, reperes, barrages-nasse, envoi-fiche, playtest.commandant-terrain: 7 files / 108 tests pass.
- playtest.commandant-compagnie + playtest.commandant-terrain + direct-logique: 39/39 pass. Before the changes listed in deviations, 2 tests failed there.
- integration.mouvement-motorise, playtest.commande, playtest.ordres-clairs, ui-command.barrage-passants, ui-command.panneaux: 5 files / 38 tests pass.
- integration.colonnes, integration.colonnes-bravm, session.cycle-de-vie, integration.patrouilles: 6 pass, 11 skipped (the skips are already in those files).
- No tests/unit/playtest.commandant-mission-*.test.ts file exists in the worktree yet, so none was run.
deviations: I added three new files to direct/ that the plan does not list: types.ts (shared types, to avoid import cycles), env.ts (the read-only builder directEnvFromCore and designationAt; needed for the real-map tests and reusable by P8) and index.ts as the single entry point.

Small edit in src/input/buttons.ts (P9's file): the 4 new Buttons added to BUTTON_TABLE (indices 43–46), CONTEXTS ('commun') and NAMES, because the `satisfies Record<Button, number>` check makes the contract change fail tsc otherwise. No key bindings were added; that stays with P9.

Small, local edit in src/ui/command/core.ts (P8's file): new private drivesTo() using motorizes(), now used for the implicit motorized order (the old farFor() stays for the avec_moi path). Without it the card would have said « à pied » while the sim still boarded the commandant's company and waited for him (playtest.commandant-compagnie was red). This is the B2 fix: a unit that contains the player on foot no longer drives.

Small edit in src/ui/command/tacticalScreen.ts (P10's file): when N (Encercler) has no candidate because fewer than 2 units are in scope, the map says REFUS.encercler (or REFUS.personne with none) instead of « rien à désigner pour l'instant ».

Four existing tests updated on purpose, because the plan changes the behaviour: playtest.commandant-compagnie (T + « Y aller » at 600 m with the commandant on foot now goes on foot; no column waits for him); ui-command.after-convoy and ui-command.barrage-passants-convoi (they used the company, which contains the commandant, to trigger a motorized move; they now use a section); ui-command.reperes (Encercler gets no candidates with zero units; the test environment now has two sections).

BRAV-M thresholds in travel.ts are set to what sim/police/command/bravm.ts does today: BRAVM_RIDE_MIN = 0 (mounted, she always rides), BRAVM_REMOUNT_MIN = 250 (on foot, she remounts beyond 250 m). With the §4.1.2 values (60 / 150 m), playtest.commandant-terrain failed (the card said vehicles, the BRAV-M walked). P4 must change both bravm.ts and these constants together.

The default addressee (who.ts) has its own pure ranking (free / « avec vous » first, oldest order otherwise, 20 s recent-order rule, capabilities) instead of calling bestUnit.proposeWho. proposeWho needs a CardLine and CardEnv and uses a different notion of « free ». The card's « Qui » is unchanged.
French typography: strings use a non-breaking space before « : » and before units (« 90 m », « Secours ici : blessé au sol »), as in the rest of the code. The plan text shows plain spaces.
No shared HUD font-metrics table existed, so words.ts has its own Helvetica/Arial width table (textWidthPx, fitsPill) and assumes 8 px pill padding.
The ordre prêt line carries no key prefix. keyedLine(KEY_GO, text) adds « Entrée » (an en space as separator), so the HUD can use the real key label from labels.ts.

Tests of rules a and b (detainee, cellular van) and of each poste use hand-built environments. The real game has no crewed cellular van squad yet (P5) and no Confier / Remettre services yet (P12/P13). Rules c, d, e, f, g, h and i run on the real Concorde map, seed 21.

Old « F puis 6 » (Pousser) now gives Disperser, as §1.2 decides; Pousser moved to « Plus… » 9. This contradicts P9's planned test wording (« never refoulement unless it already did »). My wheel test allows only key 6, which is locked until the sommations are done.
openIssues: P8: core.ts farFor() is still used for the avec_moi follow path (with a 250 m constant). Only the implicit motorized order uses motorizes(). wholeCandidate's waitsForYou and preview's « La colonne vous attend » text can no longer trigger (a unit containing the player on foot never drives); P8 can remove them. reperes.ts CardEnv.farFor (another 250 m copy) and the 250 m in orders.ts (texts of 'colonne' / 'faire_mouvement') have no owner in the plan and still say 250 m.
P4: set BRAVM_RIDE_MIN to 60 and BRAVM_REMOUNT_MIN to 150 in src/ui/command/direct/travel.ts in the same change as bravm.ts §4.1.2, and keep playtest.commandant-terrain green.

« Aller constater »: the card label and its explanation are done, but in the sim a troupe still refuses an interpeller order with no witnessed offence (ops.ts startTask: « Aucun individu à interpeller sur fait constaté »). preview.ts then says « refusera l'ordre ». The §4.3 behaviour (the unit goes 10 m from him and arrests at the first offence) is assigned to no package.

env.ts expects these service methods (a rule is only offered when its service exists): 'police.arrests'.takeOver(targetId, byPlayer) (P13, as in the plan); 'law.custody'.handover(actorId) for « Remettre » by Entrée (P12 — this method name is my choice); 'transfer'.depart(vanSquadId) (P14 — my choice too); 'police.command'.arrive (already exists). P12 and P14 should use these names or update env.ts.
env.ts detects cellular vans as squads whose vehicle kind is 'fourgon_cellulaire'. Today's van is crewless and belongs to no squad, so it does not appear until P5 creates crewed vans.
playerOrder(): env.ts falls back to squad.order when byPlayer is set. P8 must pass opts.playerOrder (CommandCore.playerOrder) for the 'done' flag, the verb and the place.

Nothing outside direct/ uses the new logic yet (runtime P8, keys and designation P9, HUD P10, phone P11), and no binding exists for the new Buttons (P9). The only effects in the running game today are the card fixes, the drive rule (card, Qui and core implicit motorization) and the Encercler message on the map.

Changes are uncommitted, as the workflow requires. The user asked to save everything; a patch and an archive of the new files are in /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-SafeDeal/f854eafd-7c66-528c-834c-30dfeec78944/scratchpad/ordres-directs/sauvegarde-P1/. The coordinator should commit soon.
